conventions: Add the Backstage Apache 2.0 license header with Copyright 2026 The Backstage Authors on newly created source and migration files only; keep existing copyright headers on edited files unchanged.
Format all TypeScript, JavaScript, YAML, and Markdown files with Prettier (2-space indentation, single quotes, trailing commas, 80-col wrap).
Tag all new symbols exported from @backstage/catalog-model and @backstage/catalog-client with @public JSDoc comments so API Extractor reports succeed without warnings.
In frontend tests, prefer screen and findBy* queries from @testing-library/react over waitFor, and do not introduce any data-testid attributes.

Follow docs/contribute/doc-style-guide.md for documentation edits and use minor semver bumps across all five affected packages (@backstage/catalog-model, @backstage/catalog-client, @backstage/plugin-catalog-backend, @backstage/plugin-catalog, @backstage/plugin-techdocs) in five separate changeset files, each with a message about its own package only.

decisions.choice: Export ANNOTATION_PREVIOUS_NAMES = 'backstage.io/previous-names' from packages/catalog-model/src/entity/constants.ts and parseEntityPreviousNames(entity: Entity): string[] from packages/catalog-model/src/entity/ref.ts (re-exported via entity/index.ts and package root).
rejected: Inline parsing separately inside catalog-backend and catalog-client
decisions.reason: Sharing the parser in @backstage/catalog-model ensures identical comma-splitting, trimming, defaultKind: entity.kind, defaultNamespace: entity.metadata.namespace || DEFAULT_NAMESPACE, same-kind validation, self-ref filtering, and deduplication across performStitching and InMemoryCatalogClient.

decisions.topic: Database schema for previous entity names
decisions.choice: Create table final_entity_previous_names in migration 20261104000000_previous_entity_names.js with entity_id (notNullable, FK to final_entities.entity_id ON DELETE CASCADE) and previous_entity_ref (notNullable), unique constraint final_entity_previous_names_entity_id_ref_uniq on (entity_id, previous_entity_ref), index final_entity_previous_names_entity_id_idx on entity_id, and index final_entity_previous_names_previous_entity_ref_idx on previous_entity_ref.
rejected: Querying the search table on relations/annotations at read time
Modifying entitiesBatch or normal entity lookup queries
decisions.reason: Isolates former-name storage to a dedicated indexed table tied to stitched final_entities via ON DELETE CASCADE and keeps entitiesBatch and existing query shapes in queries.md completely untouched (AC-5).

decisions.topic: Redirect resolution and permission filtering in DefaultEntitiesCatalog and AuthorizedEntitiesCatalog
decisions.choice: Add entityRedirect?(request: EntityRedirectRequest): Promise<EntityRedirectResponse | undefined> to EntitiesCatalog with filter?: FilterPredicate; DefaultEntitiesCatalog normalizes the requested entityRef, returns undefined if a stitched live entity exists in final_entities for that ref, queries final_entity_previous_names joined with final_entities (applying request.filter via applyEntityFilterToQuery as entitiesBatch does), and returns { entityRef } only when exactly one stitched authorized entity matches; AuthorizedEntitiesCatalog reads (await this.permissionApi.authorizeConditional(...))[0] and builds the FilterPredicate via this.permissionPredicate.
rejected: Returning one of multiple matching entities arbitrarily
Typing EntityRedirectRequest.filter as legacy EntityFilter instead of FilterPredicate
decisions.reason: Matches EntitiesBatchRequest.filter and AuthorizedEntitiesCatalog.entitiesBatch while guaranteeing live entity precedence (AC-3), 404 on ambiguous multi-claimants (AC-3), and permission enforcement on redirect targets (FR-6, AC-4).

decisions.choice: Declare getEntityRedirectByRef?(entityRef: string | CompoundEntityRef, options?: CatalogRequestOptions): Promise<CatalogEntityRedirect | undefined> as an optional method on the CatalogApi interface while implementing it concretely on CatalogClient and InMemoryCatalogClient.
decisions.reason: Keeps existing CatalogApi mocks outside the write allowlist (such as plugins/catalog-react/src/testUtils/catalogApiMock.ts) assignable to CatalogApi under yarn tsc while providing full implementations on CatalogClient and InMemoryCatalogClient.

decisions.topic: Frontend redirect notifications and route preservation in Catalog and TechDocs
decisions.choice: In useEntityFromUrl (Catalog), preserve useRouteRefParams, useAsyncRetry with refresh, and the errorApi guard for missing name, adding the redirect lookup inside a try/catch only after getEntityByRef misses (falling back to the not-found state on redirect lookup errors) and hiding the entity only while a redirect is pending; in useExternalRedirect (TechDocs), use useLocation() and useParams() to preserve sub-path, query string, and hash when getEntityByRef misses, posting a transient info alert via useApiHolder().get(alertApiRef)?.post(...) and navigating with { replace: true }.
rejected: Replacing useAsyncRetry with useAsync in useEntityFromUrl or letting getEntityRedirectByRef errors prevent the not-found fallback
decisions.reason: Preserves the existing refresh and not-found fallback behavior in useEntityFromUrl, uses standard react-router-dom hooks, and satisfies FR-10, FR-11, FR-12, FR-13, AC-7, and AC-8.

units.behaviour: Add parseEntityPreviousNames(entity: Entity): string[] to parse, normalize, validate, filter, and deduplicate backstage.io/previous-names entries.
rules: 1. Import ANNOTATION_PREVIOUS_NAMES alongside DEFAULT_NAMESPACE from './constants' and import { KubernetesValidatorFunctions } from '../validation/KubernetesValidatorFunctions'.
2. Read rawAnnotation = entity.metadata?.annotations?.[ANNOTATION_PREVIOUS_NAMES]; if typeof rawAnnotation !== 'string' or !rawAnnotation.trim() or !entity.kind or !entity.metadata?.name, return [].
3. Compute entityNamespace = entity.metadata.namespace || DEFAULT_NAMESPACE and currentRef = stringifyEntityRef({ kind: entity.kind, namespace: entityNamespace, name: entity.metadata.name }).
4. Split rawAnnotation on ',', trim each entry, skip empty strings, and inside a try/catch call parseEntityRef(entry, { defaultKind: entity.kind, defaultNamespace: entityNamespace }).

5. Skip any entry where parseEntityRef throws, where parsed.kind.toLocaleLowerCase('en-US') !== entity.kind.toLocaleLowerCase('en-US'), or where !KubernetesValidatorFunctions.isValidKind(parsed.kind) || !KubernetesValidatorFunctions.isValidNamespace(parsed.namespace) || !KubernetesValidatorFunctions.isValidObjectName(parsed.name).
6. Normalize each valid entry with stringifyEntityRef(parsed), skip any entry equal to currentRef, deduplicate while preserving order using a Set<string>, and return Array.from(result).

units.behaviour: Implement DefaultEntitiesCatalog.entityRedirect without altering entitiesBatch or any existing catalog query methods.
rules: 1. Import parseEntityRef alongside Entity and stringifyEntityRef from '@backstage/catalog-model', EntityRedirectRequest and EntityRedirectResponse from '../catalog/types', and DbFinalEntityPreviousNamesRow from '../database/tables'.
2. Do not modify entitiesBatch or any existing method in DefaultEntitiesCatalog (AC-5, NFR-1).
3. In async entityRedirect(request: EntityRedirectRequest): Promise<EntityRedirectResponse | undefined>, normalize targetRef = stringifyEntityRef(parseEntityRef(request.entityRef)).

4. First check if a stitched live entity already exists at targetRef: query this.database<DbFinalEntitiesRow>('final_entities').where('final_entities.entity_ref', targetRef).whereNotNull('final_entities.final_entity').select('final_entities.entity_id').first(); if found, return undefined (live entity takes precedence, AC-3, NFR-4).

5. Build a query on this.database<DbFinalEntityPreviousNamesRow>('final_entity_previous_names').join('final_entities', 'final_entity_previous_names.entity_id', 'final_entities.entity_id').where('final_entity_previous_names.previous_entity_ref', targetRef).whereNotNull('final_entities.final_entity').

6. If request?.filter is provided, apply query = applyEntityFilterToQuery({ filter: request.filter, targetQuery: query, onEntityIdField: 'final_entities.entity_id', knex: this.database }), matching entitiesBatch.

7. Select distinct 'final_entities.entity_ref as entity_ref' ordered by 'final_entities.entity_ref' asc with .limit(2); return { entityRef: rows[0].entity_ref } only when rows.length === 1 and Boolean(rows[0].entity_ref), otherwise return undefined.

units.behaviour: Authorize entityRedirect in AuthorizedEntitiesCatalog using catalogEntityReadPermission and conditional permission filters.
rules: 1. Import EntityRedirectRequest and EntityRedirectResponse from '../catalog/types'.

Implement async entityRedirect(request: EntityRedirectRequest): Promise<EntityRedirectResponse | undefined> which reads const authorizeDecision = (await this.permissionApi.authorizeConditional([{ permission: catalogEntityReadPermission }], { credentials: request.credentials }))[0]; matching entitiesBatch.
3. If authorizeDecision.result === AuthorizeResult.DENY, return undefined.

rules: 1. 3. Keep useAsyncRetry (exposing retry: refresh) with dependencies [catalogApi, kind, namespace, name]: first call const foundEntity = await catalogApi.getEntityByRef({ kind, namespace, name }); if foundEntity is defined, return { entity: foundEntity, redirectUrl: undefined }.

4. Only when foundEntity is undefined and name is truthy, wrap the redirect lookup in a try { const redirect = await catalogApi.getEntityRedirectByRef?.({ kind, namespace, name }); ... } catch { // ignore redirect lookup errors and fall back to not-found state } block (matching useExternalRedirect): if redirect?.entityRef is returned, parse targetRef = parseEntityRef(redirect.entityRef) and normalize currentRef = stringifyEntityRef({ kind, namespace, name }) and targetRefStr = stringifyEntityRef(targetRef); if targetRefStr !== currentRef, compute currentBase = entityRoute({ kind, namespace, name }) and targetBase = entityRoute({ kind: targetRef.kind, namespace: targetRef.namespace, name: targetRef.name }), extract any sub-route suffix = location.pathname.startsWith(currentBase) ? location.pathname.slice(currentBase.length) : '', build redirectUrl = `${targetBase}${suffix}${location.search}${location.hash}`, post a transient info alert via apiHolder.get(alertApiRef)?.post({ message: `Redirected from ${currentRef} to ${targetRefStr} as the entity was renamed.`, severity: 'info', display: 'transient' }), and return { entity: undefined, redirectUrl }; if no redirect is found or if getEntityRedirectByRef throws, return { entity: undefined, redirectUrl: undefined } so the page falls back to the not-found state.

5. Derive const entity = value?.entity; and const redirectUrl = value?.redirectUrl; so that when refresh() is invoked on a directly resolved entity, useAsyncRetry retains value.entity and keeps the entity content mounted while loading.

6. Keep the existing useEffect checking if (!name) { errorApi.post(new Error('No name provided!')); navigate('/'); }, add a useEffect that calls if (redirectUrl) { navigate(redirectUrl, { replace: true }); }, and return { entity: redirectUrl ? undefined : entity, loading: loading || Boolean(redirectUrl), error, refresh }.

units.behaviour: Document the backstage.io/previous-names annotation and its redirect and conflict semantics in well-known-annotations.md.
rules: 1. Add a ### backstage.io/previous-names section right after the backstage.io/orphan section.
2. Show a YAML example with backstage.io/previous-names: 'old-name, legacy-namespace/old-name'.

3. Explain that the value is a comma-separated list of former names or entity references (name, namespace/name, or kind:namespace/name) of the same kind, defaulting to the entity's own kind and namespace.

4. Explain that when a user navigates to a Catalog entity page or TechDocs reader page for a missing entity, Backstage checks for a redirect from backstage.io/previous-names and redirects to the renamed entity while displaying an informational alert.
5. Explicitly state that a live entity with that name always takes precedence over a redirect, and that another entity of the same kind claiming the same former name turns that redirect into a 404.

units.behaviour: Document the GET /entities/by-name/{kind}/{namespace}/{name}/redirect endpoint in docs/features/software-catalog/api.md.
rules: 1. Add a ### `GET /entities/by-name/{kind}/{namespace}/{name}/redirect` section right after ### `GET /entities/by-name/{kind}/{namespace}/{name}/ancestry`.

2. Document that it resolves the redirect target for a former entity name declared via the backstage.io/previous-names annotation and returns 200 OK with JSON { "entityRef": "component:default/new-name" }.

Explicitly state that it returns a 404 error when no entity claims that former name, when a live entity currently exists with that reference, when another entity of the same kind claims the same former name (turning that redirect into a 404), or when the caller lacks catalog.entity.read permission for the target entity.
